technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure create potential mean-reversion setup, but lack of momentum confirmation, negative short-term technicals, and weak ADX conviction make this a low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: INVH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 20 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional sales (447+ days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (389.12) with FOMC event today and earnings in 20 days creates severe macro headwinds for real estate sector despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI across all periods combined with long-term EMA/SMA bullish alignment and price near support (35.0464) creates textbook mean-reversion setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Lack of momentum confirmation (negative MACD, negative AO, weak ADX), no institutional/insider accumulation, FOMC event today, earnings risk in 20 days, and VIX crisis (389.12) create severe macro headwinds that outweigh oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and long-term EMA/SMA bullish structure create mean-reversion potential, but FOMC event today combined with VIX crisis (389.12) and earnings risk in 20 days eliminate acceptable risk/reward for swing trade entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC volatility spike today and earnings announcement in 20 days could trigger sharp drawdown before mean-reversion thesis plays out; macro headwinds outweigh technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical oversold setup insufficient to overcome macro/fundamental headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already 7 positions in Real Estate sector; adding INVH increases concentration risk during VIX crisis without conviction support.
